List Functions

List utility functions for deduplication and pair enumeration.

plot3d.listfunctions.unique_pairs(listOfItems=[])[source]

Yield unique unordered pairs from a list of 2-tuples.

Filters out self-pairs (x, x) and duplicate reversed pairs so that (1, 2) and (2, 1) are treated as the same pair.

Parameters:

listOfItems – Iterable of (x, y) tuples.

Yields:

(x, y) pairs where x != y and the reversed pair has not already been yielded. Uses a set for O(1) duplicate lookups.
